unavailable.noAgent: Choose an agent to select its model and effort.
unavailable.muse: Muse chooses its model and effort. Paperclip has no per-task override.
unavailable.process: This agent runs a command. Its harness does not expose a model or effort setting.
unavailable.http: This agent calls an HTTP endpoint. The destination service chooses its model.
unavailable.gateway: This gateway chooses its model remotely; Paperclip has no per-task model setting for it.

searchModel: Search or paste a model ID

customHint.openrouter: Custom IDs: openrouter/provider/model. Provider access is checked when the run starts.
customHint.default: Custom model IDs can be pasted here. Provider access is checked when the run starts.
